findings.title: A single NaN in a continuous hue silently collapses the entire color gradient to one color
findings.repro:
MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import numpy as np
from hypertools.plot.colors import mat2colors
h = np.linspace(0, 1, 20); h[5] = np.nan
cols = mat2colors(h, palette='hls')
print('unique colors with 1 NaN:', len(np.unique(np.round(cols,4), axis=0)))
print('unique colors without NaN:', len(np.unique(np.round(mat2colors(np.linspace(0,1,20)),4), axis=0)))
"
findings.expected: 20 distinct colors for the 19 finite values (or a warning/error about the NaN); the gradient should survive missing values
findings.actual:
unique colors with 1 NaN: 2
unique colors without NaN: 20
(all 19 finite points render as one color [0.86,0.34,0.34], NaN point as [0.86,0.3712,0.34]; hyp.plot(pts, fmt='.', hue=h) renders this silently -- see e6_nan_continuous_hue.png)

findings.title: None entries in a categorical hue form a fully-salient unnamed color group that consumes a palette slot
findings.repro:
MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import hypertools as hyp
np.random.seed(3)
fig = hyp.plot(np.random.randn(20, 4), fmt='.', hue=['a', None, 'b', 'a']*5, legend=True, ndims=2)
ax = fig.axes[0]
print('groups:', len(ax.lines), 'legend:', [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()])
print('colors:', [matplotlib.colors.to_hex(l.get_color()) for l in ax.lines])
"
findings.expected: None-labeled points visually de-emphasized (or at minimum documented as forming an unnamed colored group), palette order stable for named categories
findings.actual:
groups: 3 legend: ['a', 'b']
colors: ['#db5f57', '#57db5f', '#5f57db'] (None group = #57db5f, the second hls slot; see e5_hue_with_none.png -- green points unexplained by the legend)
